_about: Master translation script for Kamen Rider (Japan) SFC. One entry per string printed by the text routine $80:9E70 (inline Shift-JIS text inside code; '@' = end, '\' = newline). rom_offset = PC file offset (unheadered ROM); orig_bytes includes the '@'. status: found | translated | inserted | n/a | lyric. english=null means convert the Japanese mechanically (digits/spaces only).
